heading: From the lab to the code
intro: The way I think comes from chemistry. These are the equivalences I use every day.

method.title: Hypothesis, measurement, conclusion
method.description: Before deciding, I measure. Product experiments with clear metrics (OKRs, CSAT) instead of opinions.

equations.title: Nothing is created, everything is documented
equations.description: Every architecture decision has its reactants and its products: context, alternatives, and consequences in writing.

catalysts.title: Speeding things up without burning out
catalysts.description: I'm part of a cross-functional squad and mentor 4 teammates through 1:1s and pair programming, so the team moves faster.
